title: exact-llm: bit-exact LLM inference at float16 decode speed, with zero-leak verification
description: Bit-exact large-language-model inference: the model is defined as an integer program, so every conforming implementation returns the same output bits on any machine (x86 CPUs and an NVIDIA T4; Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B, BitNet b1.58 2B4T; exact inference also on the 14.3B mixture-of-experts Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B at +0.35% perplexity). Batch-1 exact decoding runs at 0.88-1.10x of vLLM float16 on a T4. Version 0.5.0 adds zero-leak verified inference: a verifier that holds no model weights (Freivalds keys, 35.6 MB vs 7.07 GB at 7B) checks every operation exactly, attention included. In tests it rejected every forgery class tried, hidden-bit token substitutions, and one changed int8 weight out of 357,826,560. Commit-and-audit replaces a full trace with a 32-byte Merkle root (0.4-0.8 MB and 13-24 ms per audited cell); the fast GPU engine's trace verifies on a CPU; the full commitment costs +2.2% (7B) and +13.8% (1.5B) on a T4; a JavaScript verifier checks real 7B audit cells in a browser. Limits, prior and concurrent work (CommitLLM, verifiable-gemma, arXiv 2511.02620, Cankaya, tritify, samebit, bitexact-llm, idemcore and others), corrections and failures are documented in the README.
notes: Built with AI assistance (Anthropic Claude) for code and analysis.
